purpose: Free public discovery and corroboration sources used when direct X rendering is unavailable. These sources never silently become equivalent to the original X UI.

sources.name: AI FrontPage
limits: no reliable X view count
page crawl time may differ from metric snapshot time
third-party cache can lag

sources.name: X榜单
limits: third-party analytics source
the current public web reader may not expose the outbound original X permalink target
a post remains DISCOVERY_LEAD_ONLY until its original X status URL/status_id is resolved
account health/staleness must be checked before using a post as a control
paid/VIP features are outside the pipeline and must not be used

sources.name: AI Twitter Highlights
can_provide: explicit likes/bookmarks/views when written in the digest
limits: article is a secondary digest
numeric prose is not exact unless explicitly stated
daily publication may lag the underlying X post

sources.name: Dahei AI realtime
limits: no guaranteed engagement metrics
generic realtime URL can be served from an old crawler cache

sources.name: X-TechCon
limits: secondary publisher
engagement metrics may be absent

sources.name: AGI Pulse
limits: early view values may be approximate
observation timestamps may be relative rather than exact

sources.name: TSN Media
limits: secondary source
not a substitute for X reach metrics

sources.name: Thread Reader App
limits: may not expose current engagement metrics
new thread permalink can lag indexing

sources.name: TwStalker / Twiscan / Zamantika
limits: original X permalink may be missing
metric order/labels differ by mirror
do not infer unlabeled metric positions

rules: X post freshness is determined from the original post time or a valid Snowflake-derived published_at, not from a search result's crawl date.
A web crawler's crawled_at is evidence about the cached page snapshot only; it is never automatically metric_as_of.
If a generic aggregator page is visibly serving content older than the target status, do not use that page as current metric evidence even if the page URL itself is live.

For RECENT_0_24H or RECENT_24_48H admission, at least one public source must contain the exact current status_id/permalink or exact post text attributable to that status; otherwise keep it as DISCOVERY_LEAD_ONLY.
For numeric engagement fields, the source must label the metric next to the exact status/post. Unlabeled number positions remain unmapped.
Untimed labeled metrics may be retained as observations with metric_as_of=null and source_freshness_state=CURRENT_BUT_UNTIMED, but they cannot be compared as a time series.
If cached observations imply impossible decreasing cumulative metrics and their timestamps are unknown, set canonical metrics to null and retain every observation as conflict evidence.
If the source snapshot date is provably earlier than the post's Snowflake published_at, reject its metrics for that post as STALE_CONFIRMED.
A real x.com/<handle>/status/<id> permalink is preferred whenever available.
Direct X 403 does not invalidate a permalink corroborated by multiple public sources.
Snowflake-derived published_at is allowed only from a real numeric X status_id and must be marked X_SNOWFLAKE_STATUS_ID.
Third-party engagement values must preserve source, snapshot uncertainty and source_freshness_state.
Explicit secondary exposure/like/comment values may guide control discovery, but cannot enter the canonical recent cohort until the original X status identity is resolved.
If two untimed mirrors show impossible decreasing cumulative metrics, canonical metric fields become null and all observations are retained as conflicting evidence.
Mirror-only posts without a resolved original status URL can be retained as discovery leads but cannot be promoted to ORIGINAL_PERMALINK_CORROBORATED.
Never use a paid source or paid feature to fill a gap in this free-only pipeline.
